about: Ivy N. Cadle is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027. He works at Baker, Donelson, Bearman, Caldwell & Berkowitz, PC, located in Macon, Georgia, and provides legal services for issues involving Eminent Domain, Business Litigation, Alternative Dispute Resolution and Land Use / Zoning to the surrounding community.
Ivy Cadle completed legal studies at Mercer University Walter F. George School of Law and graduated with the class of 2007. Ivy Cadle passed the bar in 2007.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
